edits.text: - Do not cut inside numeric expressions or ranges: keep numbers with their multipliers (million, percent, etc.), units, and both endpoints of ranges together. Splitting numerals from units or the ends of a range often yields incoherent or mistranslated numeric phrases when pieces are translated separately.

- Avoid cutting between a verb (or auxiliary) and its core object or complement, or between a verb and a following prepositional or infinitival complement. Keep the predicate and its core arguments together; prefer moving the break so the whole predicate stays in one piece.
